title: Radix-2 FFT with frozen twiddle table
description: Iterative Cooley-Tukey radix-2 FFT using a precomputed frozen twiddle table. Both variants read the identical f32 twiddle data — no trig calls in the butterfly loop. Magnitude-only output (N/2 values).

inputs.generation: 12 inharmonic partials + 10% xorshift32 noise, 1024 Float32 samples + frozen twiddle table

oracle.policy: N/2 magnitude f32 values. JS and Wasm read identical frozen twiddle table. Max relative error ≤ 1e-4 per non-zero bin. NaN/Inf fails.
oracle.floatingPointPolicy: JS uses f64 intermediates; Wasm uses native f32. Twiddle table is precomputed f32 for both. Tolerance accounts for f64 vs f32 representation in butterfly arithmetic.
oracle.deadCodeDefense: Complete magnitude array hashed and compared per-bin.

work.tolerance: Items, bytes, butterflies, bit-reversals, loads, stores must match exactly.
